stories.title: Vietnam's Q3 GDP growth reaches 9.95%
stories.summary: Vietnam's economy expanded 9.95% year over year in the third quarter, its fastest quarterly growth in four years, supported by strong exports.
stories.why: The acceleration is a major signal for Vietnam's economy and could influence investment, jobs, rates, and the country's full-year growth outlook.

stories.title: AI spending race raises questions about when productivity will catch up
stories.summary: A Reuters analysis says AI infrastructure investment is scaling at extraordinary levels while economists and investors debate whether productivity and new revenue will arrive quickly enough to justify the spending.
stories.why: The gap between infrastructure spending and realized productivity is becoming one of the key questions determining whether the AI boom remains sustainable.

stories.title: Capcom plans to use AI to speed up parts of game development
stories.summary: Capcom says it plans to use AI to improve development workflows around its RE Engine while maintaining its position that AI-generated content will not be used directly in its games.
stories.why: It is a useful example of a major studio separating AI-assisted production tooling from AI-generated game content, a distinction likely to shape how studios adopt the technology.

stories.title: NVIDIA shares new Wayland vs. X.Org latency testing
stories.summary: NVIDIA presented latency testing comparing Wayland and X.Org at XDC 2026 alongside work on its Display Config Server project.
stories.why: Display latency remains an important issue for Linux desktop and gaming users, and NVIDIA's work gives a clearer picture of how the modern Wayland stack is progressing.

stories.title: Saturn is at opposition as October skywatching begins
stories.summary: NASA's October skywatching guide highlights Saturn at opposition, the Orionid meteor shower, and several close Moon encounters with bright objects during the month.
stories.why: Saturn is currently at one of its best observing opportunities of the year, making this a particularly good time for telescope viewing.
